title: Free coordinates of a coordinate restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and assign a sign in $\{-1,1\}$ to each coordinate outside $J$. Form a coordinate restriction by leaving the coordinates in $J$ free and fixing each other coordinate to its assigned sign. The set of free coordinates of this restriction is exactly $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinate indices
A sign is assigned to each coordinate outside $J
